title: Ocean Hub  I  All in one [UPDATE]
features:
🌊Ocean Hub - Made by Diederikjande2e (on roblox)

Ocean Hub is a modern Roblox GUI built with WindUI, designed with a clean interface and multiple organized tabs for easy navigation. The hub features a sleek ocean‑themed design and provides a variety of useful tools and customizable settings all in one place.

The interface includes different sections such as Player controls, Camera settings, World adjustments, Server tools, and UI customization, allowing users to quickly change settings through sliders, toggles, buttons, and dropdown menus. Ocean Hub focuses on a smooth experience with a responsive UI layout and simple controls.

With its lightweight design and expandable structure, Ocean Hub is easy to update and improve with new features in future versions.
